<thought>To retrieve a template for the carbonyl‑ene retro‑disconnection, I will query the template catalog providing the target SMILES and at least one criteria list (functional_groups_broken). This satisfies the tool’s requirement and should return templates that break a ketone, which is characteristic of the carbonyl‑ene reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]","functional_groups_broken":["ketones"],"limit":5}</action_input>
